component.name: ibm-watsonx-data
component.title: IBM watsonx.data
component.description: Manage the catalogs, schemas, tables, engines and storage registrations of an IBM watsonx.data lakehouse.
component.label: cloud,database

authInstanceId.label: common
authInstanceId.description: The ID of the watsonx.data instance (on IBM Cloud, the CRN of the instance), sent in the AuthInstanceId HTTP header of every request. The CamelIBMWatsonxDataAuthInstanceId header overrides it; when neither is set, the request has no AuthInstanceId header.

serviceUrl.label: common
serviceUrl.description: The base URL of the watsonx.data REST API, to which the IBM SDK appends the resource paths, for example https://us-south.lakehouse.cloud.ibm.com/lakehouse/api/v3. The endpoint does not start without it.

catalogName.label: producer
catalogName.description: The name of the catalog for getCatalog, deleteCatalog, getAllColumns and the schema and table operations, except registerTable, which takes the catalog ID header instead. The CamelIBMWatsonxDataCatalogName header overrides it.

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints share. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its URI options override the copied values.

engineId.label: producer
engineId.description: The ID of the engine that the schema and table operations, except registerTable, run on, and of the engine that getPrestoEngine and getPrestissimoEngine return. The CamelIBMWatsonxDataEngineId header overrides it.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation to perform. The CamelIBMWatsonxDataOperation header overrides it; when neither is set, the exchange fails.

schemaName.label: producer
schemaName.description: The name of the schema for deleteSchema and the table operations, except registerTable; getAllColumns returns only the columns of this schema. The CamelIBMWatsonxDataSchemaName header overrides it. createSchema ignores this option and takes the name of the new schema from the header only.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The IBM Cloud API key, exchanged at IBM Cloud IAM for an access token that is sent to watsonx.data. Required unless oauthProfile is set; when both are set, oauthProfile is used.

oauthProfile.label: security
oauthProfile.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token of the configured identity provider is sent to watsonx.data as a Bearer token instead of an IBM Cloud API key, and obtained again when it expires. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataOperation.description: The operation to perform. Overrides the operation option.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataCatalogName.description: The name of the catalog. Overrides the catalogName option.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataSchemaName.description: The name of the schema. Overrides the schemaName option. createSchema takes the name of the new schema from this header only.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataCustomPath.description: The path within the storage bucket where createSchema creates the schema. Required for createSchema.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataTableName.description: The name of the table. Required for getTable, deleteTable, updateTable and registerTable; getAllColumns returns only the columns of this table. There is no option for it.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataMetadataLocation.description: The location of the metadata file of the table that registerTable registers, for example the S3 path of an Iceberg metadata file. Required for registerTable.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataCatalogId.description: The ID of the catalog that registerTable registers the table in. Required for registerTable, which ignores the catalogName option.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataSchemaId.description: The ID of the schema that registerTable registers the table in. Required for registerTable, which ignores the schemaName option.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataEngineId.description: The ID of the engine. Overrides the engineId option.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataStorageDescription.description: The description of the storage that createStorageRegistration registers. Required for createStorageRegistration.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataStorageDisplayName.description: The display name of the storage that createStorageRegistration registers. Required for createStorageRegistration.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataStorageManagedBy.description: Who manages the storage that createStorageRegistration registers: ibm or customer. Required for createStorageRegistration.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataStorageType.description: The type of the storage that createStorageRegistration registers, such as ibm_cos, aws_s3, s3, minio, ibm_ceph, adls_gen1, adls_gen2, google_cs, ozone or ibm_storage_scale. Required for createStorageRegistration.

CamelIBMWatsonxDataAuthInstanceId.description: The ID of the watsonx.data instance, sent in the AuthInstanceId HTTP header. Overrides the authInstanceId option.

producerIn.description: Only updateTable reads the body: the patch of the table, as a Map or as a JSON object in text, bytes, a stream or a file, sent as a JSON merge patch. No body, an empty patch or a body that is not a JSON object fails. The other operations take their input from the options and headers

producerOut.description: The response of the IBM watsonx.data SDK, such as a CatalogCollection for listCatalogs or a Table for getTable and updateTable; converted to text, it is its JSON. The delete operations set no body

label.description: A logical name of your choice for the endpoint. It is not sent to watsonx.data.
